race.comment: JOSEPHINE (5) outclassed in town two back from the wide gate, then bounced back when third over 1400m at Gunnedah in BM58 class. Finds a suitable race and will prove hard to hold out. WHISKERS (12) has disappointed in two runs back and drops a level after fading in the straight when ninth over 1400m here in C2 grade. Gets the right run and deserves another chance. MARS LANDING (10) back from a lengthy break and has not appeared since he finished tenth over 1300m at this track last January. Fitted with the one trial over 1007m and has a host of gear changes. Place preferred. CHESTIME (1) is resuming from a break. Recent trial winner at Muswellbrook. Opened last campaign with a fifth at Scone over 1250m. Key runner.
